backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, reminders, and messages with public-mode operations and per-user storage maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing concise descriptions of major frontend components and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables defining light/dark color palettes and layout tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component switching between reminders and messages inside the shared layout without auth gating.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button handling authentication and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for collecting and saving a user name on first setup with form validation.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App shell rendering header, navigation, content area, and footer with view-switching controls.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Messag: Form for composing and sending public-mode messages with voice input and validation.
Renders a list of messages with timestamps, optional reminder details, and delete support.
Loads all messages and displays a composer and message list with a loading state.
frontend/src/components/reminders/DueNow: Shows reminders that are currently due and allows marking them as completed.
frontend/src/components/reminders/Remind: Dialog form for creating or editing reminders with voice input and date/time handling.
Displays reminders with filtering, editing, completion, deletion, sending, and speaking options.
Button that uses text‑to‑speech to read a reminder aloud or stop playback.
Top‑level reminders page with a new‑reminder button, due‑now panel, and reminders list.
frontend/src/components/reminders/SendRe: Dialog for sending a reminder as a shared message through a backend call.
Microphone button enabling speech‑to‑text dictation with start/stop and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Returns identity and caller user profile info along with authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useDueNowReminders.ts: Computes reminders that are currently due by polling and filtering uncompleted items.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, reminders, and messages via an actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Implements a hook for browser speech recognition with start/stop controls, transcript handling, and error reporting.
frontend/src/hooks/useTextToSpeech.ts: Provides a hook for using the browser speech synthesis API to speak or stop spoken text.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining a warm color palette, dark mode, and UI animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, color variables, plugins, and layout settings.
project_state.json: Defines the project's state, architecture notes, and a list of existing features for a shared, no-login organizer and messenger app.
